exposure: state-level percentage of uninsured women aged 19-44 years
cohort: Participants were respondents with singleton, live births from the 2016-2019 Pregnancy Risk Assessment Monitoring Survey.
finding: Respondents from states with 7% or more uninsured women of reproductive age had an increased risk of low birth weight compared to those from states with less than 7% uninsured, although no clear dose-response gradient was observed.
cross-section timing: Data from the 2016-2019 Pregnancy Risk Assessment Monitoring Survey.
